notes: Built with upstream jni/Android.mk for arm64, with CHD support, the software NEON GPU, ARM64 dynamic recompiler and a pinned GIT_VERSION, packaged as libpcsx_rearmed_libretro.so. Reports library_version r26 c8816799. The archive includes its libretro and CHD dependencies; the unused libpicofe submodule is not required. Uses its high-level BIOS unless a supported PlayStation BIOS dump is in the system folder. No BIOS, firmware, game data or ROMs bundled.
